dig (1)              - DNS lookup utility
host (1)             - DNS lookup utility
nslookup (1)         - query Internet name servers interactively
resolvectl (1)       - Resolve domain names, IPV4 and IPv6 addresses, DNS resource records, and services
ssh (1)              - OpenSSH remote login client
ssh-keygen (1)       - OpenSSH authentication key utility
tar (1)              - an archiving utility
dig (1p)             - POSIX copy, should be skipped
getaddrinfo (3)      - network address and service translation
